text:
mira: Heads up: were launching a short-lived billing/quotas policy change next week to reduce 429 churn for bursty apps and to apply transitional credits for affected customers. Short summary below.

devon: whats the plan?

mira: Plan: (A) introduce a 20-30s burst smoothing window at the API edge to queue short spikes instead of immediate throttles; (B) during the transition period well apply a "transitional credit" to customers who would otherwise be charged overage for traffic during the window. This is NOT a change to baseline pricing.

rachel: timeframe?

mira: Window: 2026-04-07 04:00 UTC -> 2026-04-21 04:00 UTC. We may extend based on telemetry.

infra-eng: Implementation note: smoothing = server-side short buffer + tokenized dequeue with backpressure. Per-key steady-state QPS limits remain enforced. Well add a toggle and automated rollback if P95 latency increases by >70ms.

billing-bot: System: transitional credits created as invoice adjustment lines labeled TRANSITIONAL_CREDIT_2026. Sample invoice payload snippet: `{"line_items":[{"code":"USAGE","amount_cents":12345},{"code":"TRANSITIONAL_CREDIT_2026","amount_cents":-345}]}`. Accounting: line code = TRANSITIONAL_CREDIT_2026.

support-lead: how do we communicate to customers?

mira: We're doing three things: 1) customer email tomorrow morning with examples and FAQ; 2) console banner starting 2026-04-05; 3) AMs get templated language and a CSV of impacted accounts post-rollout.

devon: does this touch trials/free credits?

mira: Trials: no change to expiry rules. If a trial ends during the window and the customer bursts traffic, we will prevent sudden invoice charges by applying the transitional credit pro-rata. Well also include a note in the invoice JSON: `policy_note: transitional-credit-rollout`.

billing-bot: Note to billing ops: credits are capped at 1000 USD per account for this window to limit exposure. Please ensure mapping to GL account code: 412-TC.

support-lead: Ill prep a short runbook and canned responses for Tier 1. Include one-liners for Billing Qs.

rachel: any impact to Dedicated or Private customers?

mira: Dedicated with committed capacity are excluded. Private deployments remain under existing contracts. Only Hosted customers see smoothing + transitional credit.

infra-eng: Monitoring: add grafana panels for smoothed_queue_length, edge_throttle_rate, and invoice_adjustment_count. Alert if invoice_adjustment_count > 500 in a 24h window.

devon: engineering action items?

mira: Action list:
- @devon add smoothing toggle + auto-rollback PR by Wed EOD.
- @billing-bot / billing ops validate GL mapping and credit caps.
- @support-lead produce canned responses and update help center.
- @rachel prepare AM outreach and a post-rollout CSV export.

billing-bot: Automated: customers will see an invoice line item `TRANSITIONAL_CREDIT_2026` with negative cents reflecting pro-rata adjustment. Billing UI will show a tooltip "Transitional credit for smoothing rollout".

mira: Risks: possible short-term margin impact, complexity in invoice reconciliation. Upside: reduce support load from noisy 429s and improve developer experience.

support-lead: Acknowledged. Ill train L2 on the invoice structure and escalation path.

devon: OK. Ill link the PR and monitoring dashboards here when ready.

mira: Thanks all  please escalate urgent issues to me or @infra-eng.
